Music for Ludvig Holberg's Play "Ulysses von Ithacia"

event.desc: Performance celebrating the 200th anniversary of Ludvig Holberg.

history.p: The music for Holberg's play was written for the festive performance celebrating his 200th anniversary.

physDesc.physMedium: 1 single folio bound in brown paperboard cover with brown cloth spine. Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. Paginated 1-2. Heading on p. 1: "1884. Ulysses-Marsch. / Forspil til Holbergs Ulysses v. Ithacien". At the bottom of p.2 Gade has written: "Hr Rung / Cort Adlersgade."

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in brown paperboard cover with brown cloth spine. Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. In the left-hand margin on p. 1 Gade has written: "Introduzione marziale. Forspil til Holbergs Ulysses v. Ithacien. / Opført ved Holbergfesten 1884." On the last page "Introduzione marziale / af Niels W. Gade."

physLoc.identifier: C II, 6 Gades Samling 402 (Kapsel T - V)

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in cardboard cover with brown cloth spine. Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. Paginated 1-13. Last page unnumbered and blank. Heading on p. 1: Marcia (in Gade's hand). In upper right-hand corner signed by Gade. In left-hand margin: "Introduzione Marziale til Ulysses von Ithaca" also in Gade's hand. On p. 13 three deleted bars with the heading: "(Spilles naar Tæppet gaar op.)" and after the double bar: "Musiken holder op naar Frits træder frem på Scenen". Beneath: "Componeret / og instrumenteret af Gade / Denne Renskrift / af Fr. Rung."
